## WHY -- and this is the real output, all measured, not argued
1. NO RESTORING FORCE. phase += quanta is the correct FIRST HALF of a second-order integrator; nothing computes the second half. QuantaExchangeRule branches on the QUANTA difference (coupling velocities = a dashpot = pure damping) while it is HANDED angleA/angleB and ignores them. Position coupling is what gives waves. Hence relaxation, never propagation.
2. THE MAXIMUM PRINCIPLE IS FALSE. CollisionSweep accumulates deltas additively, ~18.8% of ticks carry same-member multi-contacts, and overdrawing below zero is legal by design. It never held.
3. sum q^2 IS NOT MONOTONE EVEN FOR THE INCUMBENT. The per-pair algebra -2(a-b)+2 does not survive the synchronous update: 1 -> (-2,1,1,1) takes sum q^2 from 1 to 7. Dissipation is pairwise, not per-tick.
4. A PHASE-COUPLED RULE DOES NOT FIX IT. Tested. It propagates where the incumbent cannot and conserves the signed total exactly -- but a dead lattice with no strike self-excites from 0 to 39528 over 2000 ticks. Narrow phase-gated contact turns a restoring coupling into a PARAMETRIC PUMP (bounded at full duty, ~t^2 unbounded below ~3% duty; real contact density is ~1e-4). Preserved on branch experiment/phase-coupled-rule.
5. THE ABSORBING BACKGROUND IS THE DOMINANT DEFECT, and it is amplitude-independent. 99.3% of campaign collisions are ~28 PERMANENTLY FROZEN (0,0) pairs re-counted every tick, because zero-quanta members never rotate and the exchange rule's equal-quanta fixed point makes contacting pairs stick.
6. THE LGA IS NOT A JITTERBUG -- PROVEN (USER DECISION 15). LengthTable is exactly the distance to a SQUARE boundary and has a derivative discontinuity at each corner; the jitterbug's radial law sqrt((axial + Z cos a)^2 + rho^2) is ANALYTIC everywhere. An analytic function and a function with a cusp cannot be equal under any smooth reparameterisation. They agree only in total span (both sqrt(2)) and are approximately INVERSE in shape.
7. ALIASING IS A VARIANCE PATHOLOGY, NOT A MEAN SHIFT. Exact enumeration over all 3600 phases x 10896 ribbons gives E[contact ticks] bit-identical for every q from 0 to 600. |q| is the wrong variable; the constraint is gcd(q,3600).

No distributed system reaches a configuration at one moment across its extent. The in-phase icosahedral state is reachable only by fiat -- by an observer choosing the decisive instant and imposing it on a simulation -- so it is a fact about what can be done to a model, not about what the medium does. And even the fiat is finite: it is always N units, never all of them.
